Looking at the two CSV tables, I need to identify matching columns between Table A and Table B.

Table A columns:
- Unnamed: 0
- military_base_name
- coordinates
- longtitudes (note: misspelled)
- latitudes
- description

Table B columns:
- dldBxBN4tl4 (contains latitude values)
- SmRhS/d2xpk (contains numeric codes)
- gVRuuM0qimI (contains longitude values)
- 7SxcDOM+98w (contains zeros)
- VP8coLynuXw (contains descriptions/military unit info)

Mapping based on data types and values:
- latitudes (A) → dldBxBN4tl4 (B) - both contain latitude coordinates
- longtitudes (A) → gVRuuM0qimI (B) - both contain longitude coordinates  
- description (A) → VP8coLynuXw (B) - both contain military unit descriptions
